🚀 AIUsage | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing and monitoring multiple AI service subscriptions and their usage from a single, convenient dashboard on macOS.
✨ Key Features: • Unified dashboard for 12+ AI providers (Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, etc.) • Multi-account management with independent refresh and one-click CLI switching • Detailed usage statistics including cost and token breakdown • Claude Code Proxy for using various models with Claude Code
📖 Summary: AIUsage is a macOS application designed to centralize the management of various AI subscriptions. It provides a unified dashboard to track usage, costs, and accounts across numerous AI providers, offering integrated proxies and gateways for seamless interaction with different AI models.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ SILENTCHAIN | Java
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance web application security testing by providing AI-driven passive vulnerability detection within Burp Suite.
✨ Key Features: • AI-Powered Passive Vulnerability Analysis • Multi-AI Support (Burp AI, Ollama, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure) • OWASP Top 10 Vulnerability Detection • Real-Time Traffic Analysis • Data Privacy (DataSanitizer) with Bidirectional Redaction
📖 Summary: SILENTCHAIN AI™ Community Edition is a Burp Suite extension that integrates AI models for passive vulnerability analysis of web application HTTP traffic. It identifies OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations in real-time, offering features like multi-AI provider support and data sanitization.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ deep-eye | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated, AI-enhanced penetration testing and vulnerability scanning with intelligent payload generation and professional reporting.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-AI Provider Support (11 providers with failover) • 50+ Vulnerability Checks (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, JWT deep, IDOR, GraphQL deep, CORS/CSP, supply-chain JS, etc.) • OpenAPI Ingest for seeding crawls • Context-Aware Payloads (WAF fingerprint, tech stack, CVE-aware generation) • CVE Intelligence (RAG-indexed CVE DB)
📖 Summary: Deep Eye is an advanced AI-driven penetration testing tool that orchestrates multiple AI providers for intelligent payload generation. It scans targets for over 50 vulnerability types and generates professional reports with compliance mapping, deduplication, and retest workflows.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 OpenDocs | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated generation of diverse documentation formats from source files like READMEs, Markdown, and Jupyter Notebooks.
✨ Key Features: • Converts READMEs, Markdown, and Jupyter Notebooks • Generates multiple output formats (.docx, .pptx, .pdf, .md, .json, .tex, .html) • Creates technical reports, executive decks, blog posts, Jira tickets, academic papers, social cards, FAQs, analysis reports, and more
📖 Summary: OpenDocs is a Python tool that automatically converts GitHub READMEs, Markdown files, and Jupyter Notebooks into a variety of professional documentation formats. It leverages AI to generate outputs like technical reports, executive decks, PDFs, blog posts, Jira tickets, academic papers, and even interactive knowledge graphs.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 liteparse | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Efficiently extracting structured text and spatial information from documents locally, primarily for use in LLM agents and RAG pipelines.
✨ Key Features: • Fast Text Parsing using PDFium • Flexible OCR System (Tesseract, HTTP Servers, Custom) • Complexity Detection • Screenshot Generation
📖 Summary: LiteParse is a fast, open-source document parsing tool written in Rust, designed for efficient local processing of PDFs and other document types. It extracts text with bounding boxes, supports multiple OCR engines, generates screenshots, and outputs structured Markdown, JSON, or plain text, making it suitable for RAG pipelines and LLM agents.
